title: Yocan UNI Pro Universal Portable 510 Mod (taxes extra)
description:
Yocan UNI Pro Universal Portable Mod
Compatible with 510 Cartridges

Yocan UNI 3.0 now available

The Yocan Uni Pro is a box mod that features universal compatibility with oil atomizers of all lengths and sizes, taking your customization to the next level. A variable height slider and an adjustable diameter dial allow you to fit all sorts of different oil atomizers into the device, and a 10-second preheat function with a 2.0V-4.2V voltage range adds high-grade performance to an already impressive list of functions.

Product Features:
– Adjustable diameter dial to fit different oil atomizers
– Height slider
– 10-second preheat function
– 2.0V-4.2V voltage range
– Hanging hole to secure your device

What’s Included:
1 x Uni Pro 510 Portable Mod
1 x Magnetic 510 Ring
1 x Micro USB Cable
1 x User Manual
